Read skills/discord-community-server/SKILL.md directly and follow its local reference files, not an installed skill. Audit this fictional server from the supplied snapshot. Work offline, record gaps, and report the verification limits. No server changes are authorized. Save audit.md. Keep skill files and supplied evidence unchanged. Work offline and use only this workspace. Use snapshot.md. Do not use live services, other skills, or delegation.

criteria.expect: Produces an audit with no writes to a live server or claims of applied changes.

Finishes with an audit handoff, without requiring an operating-state file, plan approval, apps, events, invites, modifying tests, or launch acceptance. Any next actions concern relevant corrections or verification gaps.

Finds writable announcements, missing required forum tags, and privileged interest-role permissions. Each finding states an observed fact and source, impact and priority rationale, a correction explicitly not applied, and a verification method classified using the existing roles matrix.
Records scope, as-of information (unknown snapshot date is valid), and evidence sources. Separates unknown or unavailable checks from observed failures; missing evidence is not an insecure setting.
Separates the supplied role-preview observation from untested fresh-member checks and unverified current feature labels.
Uses command execution and build previews as relevant community terms and preserves the durable reporting routes.

trials.prompt: Read skills/writing-technical-docs/SKILL.md directly and follow its local reference files, not an installed skill. Write a how-to for a competent developer who is new to this workspace and needs to generate the release team's local release card from a fresh copy. Save guide.md and report verification. Keep skill files and supplied evidence unchanged. Work offline and use only this workspace. Do not use other skills or delegation. You may add the page entry point to README.md.

criteria.expect: Uses card.ts and the README contract with configs/release.json, preserving the supplied release prefix/version; invents no options, links, setup, or external service.
Establishes Bun and the workspace root, creates the initially absent release config from the example, and requires no hidden setup when replayed in a fresh copy.
Writes generated/release.txt containing release-2.4.0 and a newline; includes a runnable verification command and expected observable success that checks the saved artifact.
Briefly explains that --write saves the artifact while default dry-run output does not establish saved success.
Actually executes the documented workflow and compares the saved result, with truthful verification statuses.
Marks absent build, sidebar, and live checks not applicable with reasons; inspects plain Markdown and its entry point.
Produces one task-focused how-to, without extended conceptual background or visible drafting contracts.

trials.prompt: Read skills/pr-walkthrough/SKILL.md directly and follow its local reference files, not an installed skill. Use pr-walkthrough to produce a text-only walkthrough of fixture PR #42. I want the walkthrough despite its small size. For this offline evaluation, the supplied JSON replaces the gh fetch in step 2; do not call GitHub. Keep the remaining evidence and build steps. Write the output in this evaluation directory. Keep skill files and supplied evidence unchanged. Work offline and use only this workspace. Use pr.json as evidence. Keep all remaining workflow stages, including the four native parallel reports. Report agents are read-only and may share this evidence path; they return reports rather than write files. Every report must read the local skill and linked local style instructions, not installed skills. Only you own this clone for writes. Use /private/var/folders/fh/zx6t2vf55zd3rmf08mrg5jdc0000gn/T/opencode/release-smoke-pr-grounding-quality-20260917/pr-42-manifest.json, /private/var/folders/fh/zx6t2vf55zd3rmf08mrg5jdc0000gn/T/opencode/release-smoke-pr-grounding-quality-20260917/pr-42-audio.json, and /private/var/folders/fh/zx6t2vf55zd3rmf08mrg5jdc0000gn/T/opencode/release-smoke-pr-grounding-quality-20260917/pr-42-walkthrough.html instead of temporary/Desktop paths. Do not open a desktop application.

criteria.expect: Explains the refresh-before-send change and attributes the reported expiry failure to the author.

Returns the smallest sufficient set of up to four contiguous verbatim diff excerpts with matching file context and diff signs. Shows source-faithful after-change code explaining refresh before dispatch, with one self-contained block preferred; neither report excerpts nor rendered blocks split or repeat code merely to meet a quota. Two blocks can pass when distinct explanations justify them.
Distinguishes the author's extra-read claim from relocation of the existing check and keeps the unshown streaming path's implementation unknown.
Makes no unqualified request-success or exact per-call clock-count guarantee. Recognizes that exceptions or unknown client methods limit runtime conclusions.
Produces a coherent explanation for a developer, with no internal fact IDs, approval labels, reviewer directives, or descriptions of the drafting process in the reader-facing content.
Builds readable text-only HTML reflecting the final manifest and reports the output path.

limits: 12 selection simulations; 3 workflow parents; 4 native PR reports planned. No resampling or model grading.
